<!--
  A section with a heading and the features as a grid of cards or tiles, or as rows with a picture. Icons are
  Lucide names. Axes: layout (grid, rows), columns, item (card, tile, cell: bordered tile with a round icon),
  media side (rows), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

  export type FeatureGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    action?: HeadLink;
    layout?: "grid" | "rows";
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
    item?: "card" | "tile" | "cell";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start" | "alternate";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import FeatureCards from "../components/feature-cards.svelte";
  import FeatureRows from "../components/feature-rows.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    action,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "1-3",
    item = "card",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: FeatureGridProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((item as string) === "cell")}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title="" tone={tone} density={density} measure="fill" class="py-0">
    <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="w-full">
      <Title as={2} size="sm" weight="semibold" class="leading-7" id={(id + "-title")}>
        {title}
      </Title>
      {#if action?.label}
        <Link
          href={(action?.href ?? "#/")}
          variant="default"
          class={cn(defaults.text.tiny, "shrink-0 font-medium leading-5")}
          data-testid="section-action"
        >
          {action?.label}
        </Link>
      {/if}
    </Group>
    <FeatureCards features={features} cols={cols} item={item} />
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} action={action} tone={tone} density={density}>
    {#if ((layout as string) === "rows")}
      <FeatureRows features={features} mediaSide={mediaSide} />
    {:else}
      <FeatureCards features={features} cols={cols} item={item} />
    {/if}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
